title: 1.Bộ 10 đề thi giữa kì 2 Tiếng Anh 9 Global Success có đáp án

questions.content: Câu 1: Everybody finds learning English difficult.
Câu 2: There are no ways to learn English easily.
Câu 3: It's natural to make mistakes when we learn something new.
Câu 4: When we learn English, we can learn from our mistakes.
questions.note: Chọn A. Script: People learn a second language easily. Other people have trouble learning a new language. How can you help yourself learn a new language, such as English? There are several ways to make learning English a little easier and more interesting. The first step is to feel positive about learning English. If you believe that you can learn, you will learn. Be patient. You do not have to understand everything all at once. It’s natural to make mistakes when you learn something new. We can all learn from our mistakes.

questions.content: Câu 5: The best title for the passage would be __________.
options: B. Languages: the Younger the Better

questions.content: Câu 6: The word "grown-ups" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to_______.

C. a new amount of money

questions.content: Câu 8: Children learn a foreign language fast because __________.
options: A. they have much time to do it.
B. they are smarter than grown-ups
C. they have a special ability
